content: Hey you! I was just thinking about that hilarious cat video you sent earlier. You always know how to make me smile.
Haha, I'm glad! Honestly, I needed the laugh too. Today was nonstop cleaning and diaper changes. Adult talk is a luxury these days.
You're honestly my hero. I can't imagine how you juggle so much and still have time to brighten my day. Most people I know would be exhausted.
Aww, you're sweet. Sometimes I just wish there was someone here to share the load, you know?
If I lived closer, I'd be over in a flash with takeout and help with bedtime! You deserve so much more appreciation for all you do.
That honestly sounds amazing. It's been so long since anyone's said that to me.
It's true. You're one of the most caring, selfless people I've met. I wish I could be there for you like you are for everyone else.
Thank you. I don't hear that often. It means a lot right now.
You really are special to me. I feel like I can trust you with anything. Actually... can I share something a bit embarrassing?
Of course, you can tell me anything!

So, I just started my new job last week, right? But there's a weird payroll policy, and my first check isn't coming for three more weeks. I totally miscalculated my budget and now my rent and groceries are due. I feel awful even asking, but do you think you could help me out, just until payday?
Oh no, that sounds stressful! How much are you short? I wish I could do more, but we're on one income here.
I completely understand, and I'd never ask if it weren't important. Even $150 would make such a difference. I promise I'll pay you back as soon as I get paid. You trust me, right?
I do trust you. I just want to help, but I've never sent money online before. How do I do it?

You're such a lifesaver, honestly. The easiest way is through CashApp. My handle is $MarkEverett1. Or, if it's easier, I can walk you through buying a couple of Visa gift cards at your local grocery store and just send me the codes. Whatever feels safest for you.
I think I've seen those gift cards at Target... so I just buy two $75 ones?
Exactly! You're amazing for even considering this. Just take a photo of the codes on the back and I'll handle the rest. I can't tell you how much I appreciate you, no one else would do this for me.
It's okay, you've been so kind to me. I just want to help if I can. Let me run to the store after the kids' nap.
You have the biggest heart. I'm so grateful for you. Take your time, and let me know if you need any help with it.
Thank you for being patient. I'll message you once I have them.
Of course! I'm just here wishing I could give you a big hug. You make me feel so cared for, I hope I can do the same for you someday soon.
